<title level="1" right="Spell 10" pfs="Standard">
[Incarnate Kaiju](/Spells.aspx?ID=2741)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Incarnate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=786" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 146

**Tradition**
[Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 500 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

You briefly conjure a kaiju, a massive, rampaging monster with a unique name and legendary reputation. It rises from its secluded lair to annihilate your foes. The summoned kaiju occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the kaiju below to summon.

- **Agmazar, the Star Titan** Speed 100 feet, climb 50 feet; **Arrive** ([void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)) _Channel Void_ Each foe in a 100-foot emanation takes 16d8 void damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save); **Depart** _Gravitic Repulsion_ Each foe in a 50-foot emanation is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 100 feet away unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save.

- **Agyra, the Forever Storm** Speed 80 feet, fly 200 feet; **Arrive** ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586)) _Breath of a Thousand Storms_ Agyra shoots two 1,200-foot lines of electricity, one from each of her heads. The lines can't overlap. Each creature along one of the lines takes 6d12 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. On a failure, the creature is also [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) for 1 round (for 1 minute on a critical failure); **Depart** ([sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) _Thunderous Blast_ Each creature within a 100-foot emanation takes 6d10 sonic damage with a basic Reflex save and is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) on a failed save.

- **Bezravnis, the Inferno Below** Speed 100 feet, burrow 100 feet; **Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Burrow from the Earth's Heart_ Bezravnis explodes from the ground where it was summoned, causing all creatures in a 50-foot emanation to take 8d12 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. This potentially collapses structures with the collapse effect of the _[_earthquake_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1507)_ spell, except there's no chance of falling into a fissure; **Depart** _Web Hurricane_ Bezravnis departs with a hurricane of webbing. All creatures within a 50-foot emanation must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –20-foot circumstance penalty to their Speeds until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) (or are [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until they Escape on a critical failure). The Escape DC is your spell DC.

- **Ebeshra, the Winged Razor** Speed 75 feet, fly 100 feet; **Arrive** ([teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710)) _Planar Draw_ Each foe in a 100-foot emanation is [pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 50 feet toward the center, unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. Creatures that fail and reach the center take 10d6 bludgeoning damage; **Depart** ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586)) _Storm Discharge_ All creatures in a 240-foot line takes 12d8 electricity damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save.

- **Mogaru, the Final King** Speed 100 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Trance of the King's Melody_ Mogaru manifests with a burst of the song that summoned him, requiring all foes within 60 feet who can hear him to attempt a Will save, leaving them [stunned 3](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) on a failure; **Depart** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)) _Volcanic Breath_ Mogaru unleashes his scorching breath in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 10d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save. On a failure, it also takes 4d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86).

- **Vorgozen, the Shapeless Feeder** Speed 50 feet, climb 50 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** _Pollute Magic_ Vorgozen's foul presence pollutes magic around her. Each enemy within a 60-foot emanation that's under the effects of a spell must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is [sickened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91). Any of your enemies that Casts a Spell within 60 feet of Vorgozen must attempt a Fortitude save with the same effects unless it's already sickened; **Depart** ([acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524)) _Beam of Purest Vitriol_ Each creature in a 1,200-foot line takes 10d6 acid damage and 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save.

- **Yarthoon, the Moon Grub** Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet, fly 100 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555)) _Algid Beam Barrage_ Yarthoon fires countless beams, targeting each of your enemies within 200 feet of it. The beams deal 10d6 cold damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save; **Depart** (cold, [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732)) _Frostbite Mist_ Chilling mist surges out in a 100-foot burst centered on Yarthoon and remains for 1 minute. This mist has the effects of _[_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606)_, plus any creature within the area at the end of its turn takes 5d6 cold damage (basic Fortitude save).

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 147 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Range** 30 feet **Duration** until the end of your next turn --- Your shadow peels away from your body, dancing its way to the target location and calling other shadows to join in and abandon their bodies. This spell requires the presence of a shadow and cannot be cast in complete darkness. Your shadow occupies the space of a creature of your size and has Speeds equal to yours (including fly and other alternative Speeds).

**Arrive** ([spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737)) _Dance Card_ Your shadow invites other shadows to dance with it. All enemies within a 20-foot emanation of your shadow must attempt a Will save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature’s shadow is curious and stretches toward your shadow, but it stays attached. The creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature’s shadow detaches to join the dance. The creature takes 4d6 spirit damage and is off-guard for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes 8d6 spirit damage.

**Depart** ([darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=569)) _Darkness Crescendo_ The shadows dance a short minuet, and then your shadow bows and returns to your side. It releases a globe of darkness in a 20-foot burst centered on you, which lasts for 1 minute. Light does not enter the area, and any non-magical light sources, such as torches or lanterns, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640) of your spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through this area, so creatures in it can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness. --- **Heightened (+1)** The spirit damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and 4d6 on a critical failure.

fields.text: Spell 6 Incarnate Wild Rose Three Actions Concentrate Incarnate Manipulate Plant Source Impossible Magic pg. 148 Traditions Arcane, Primal Range 100 feet Duration until the end of your next turn You call up the giant wild rose, a flower famous for both its beauty and its thorns. The rose occupies the space of a Huge creature but has no Speed. Arrive Writhing Vines A vast number of thorny vines burst from the ground, wrapping around those who threaten you. Each enemy within a 30-foot emanation of the rose takes 3d12 piercing damage and must attempt a Reflex saving throw. Critical Success The creature takes no damage. Success The creature takes half damage. Failure The creature takes full damage and is grabbed by a vine for the duration of the spell or until they Escape. Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is restrained by a vine for the duration of the spell or until they Escape. Depart (poison) Blood Pollen All creatures still grabbed or restrained by vines take 2d6 persistent poison damage. The wild rose then expels a cloud of toxic pollen in a 20-foot burst up to 60 feet away. All living creatures in the burst must attempt a Fortitude save. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is enfeebled 2 for 1 round. Failure The creature is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute. Critical Failure The creature is enfeebled 3 for 1 minute. Heightened (+2) The rose’s arrival damage increases by 1d12, and its departure damage increases by 1d6.

[Inertia Lock](/Spells.aspx?ID=2746)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 148

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You manipulate the fundamental forces of gravity to lock an item in place. The object remains in the exact spot where you released it, even floating in the air, until the spell ends or the item is broken. A creature can Interact with the object to move it up to 10 feet by succeeding at an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check equal to your spell DC (up to 20 feet on a critical success). After the item is moved, the spell’s effects resume. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) this spell.

---
**Heightened (5th)** The duration increases to 8 hours.

**Heightened (7th)** The duration is unlimited.

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 143 **Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Range** 30 feet **Target** you and 1 enemy **Duration** 2 rounds --- You twist the paths of the target, ensuring that each one leads to you. The target attempts a Will saving throw. **Critical Success** The spell has no effect.
**Success** Your pull hampers the target's footsteps. It takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.
**Failure** The target can't move any farther from you than it was when you Cast the Spell, though it can move in such a way that it maintains an equal distance. If you move farther away from the target than the initial distance, the spell ends. The targeted foe can attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) against your spell DC. If it succeeds, the spell ends.
**Critical Failure** As failure, plus the target is [pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet closer to you and falls [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31), tripping in its haste to move toward you.

<title level="1" right="Spell 5" pfs="Standard">
[Inevitable Disaster](/Spells.aspx?ID=2747)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Curse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=566" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Prediction" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=674" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 148

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Fortitude

</row>

</column>

---

You briefly glimpse cause and effect, putting into motion a chain of events that will visit doom on your enemy at some point in the future, though you’re not quite sure when or how the doom will occur. Some kind of strange accident occurs 1d4 rounds later, dealing 55 damage to the creature, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save. This happens regardless of where the target is located at the time, even if they travel to another plane. The GM should roll to determine when the damage occurs secretly and determine the form of the accident as well as the type of damage it deals; generally, the accident should be one that deals physical damage of some type (for instance, a tree branch might fall on the foe and deal bludgeoning damage, or a window might break and fling sharp slashing glass at them), though other damage types might be appropriate in more unusual environments.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 10.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 111 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Range** 30 feet **Target** up to 5 creatures **Saving Throw** Will --- You inflict your targets with a crushing doubt about everyone and everything around them. For the duration, each target is unwilling to receive any effects that require a willing target (in case the effect was secretly an attack), refuse to ingest anything (in case the substances have been replaced with poisons and cursed duplicates), doesn't treat anyone as an ally (in case its friends were replaced by an impostor), and doesn't believe anything it's told (in case of lies, though this doesn't mean the creature automatically believes the opposite either). It doesn't even fully trust its own ability to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26), as it becomes convinced it most likely remembered false information, as from a critical failure on a check to Recall Knowledge. Finally, the creature takes 6d6 mental damage at the end of each of its turns (with no save) unless it spent at least 1 action that turn [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) or otherwise interacting with its surroundings in an attempt to disbelieve the illusions that it feels are obviously surrounding it. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is affected for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is affected for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The creature is affected for 1 hour.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 149 **Tradition** [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Deities** [Seramaydiel](/Deities.aspx?ID=483), [Winlas](/Deities.aspx?ID=656) **Area** 15-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) **Target** enemies in the area **Defense** Will **Duration** varies --- You call forth the chords of a tune so catchy that foes hearing it can’t help but sing along, making it harder for them to communicate. Each target must attempt a Will save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** For 1 round, the creature can communicate only by singing along to the melody. They can speak only on their turn, and the creature must take the Perform action when they do. The result of the [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) check determines how well they sang, but the creature still communicates the information regardless of the result, which has no further mechanical impact than the time spent to take the action. A single Performance check is sufficient for any amount of speaking on the creature's turn. This effect might interfere with verbal components of spells or other [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642) abilities that rely on precise speech; in order to use such an ability successfully, the creature must succeed at a DC 5 flat check. In addition, the creature takes a –2 status penalty on linguistic [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks, as singing their threats saps away some of the menace. The creature's constant humming of the tune also makes it impossible for it to remain [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96).
**Failure** As success, but the duration is 3 rounds.
**Critical Failure** As success, but the duration is 1 hour.

It's best to know the ingress and egress points for any location you plan to rob. But it's even better to make your own! You create two portals. One appears on a flat surface you can touch, and the other appears on a different flat surface in range that you can see.

 You can move through the portals as though they were adjacent to each other. Any other creature attempting to move through the portals must succeed at a Will saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet away from their starting point to a random safe space determined by the GM.

---
**Heightened (6th)** When you Cast the Spell, you can designate up to 5 other creatures to freely move between the portals.

A spray of viscous, toxic ink jets from your fingertip to strike a target creature in the face. Make a spell attack roll against the target. **Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 338 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Deities** [Aakriti](/Deities.aspx?ID=623), [Dammar](/Deities.aspx?ID=536), [Ghlaunder](/Deities.aspx?ID=343), [Kitumu](/Deities.aspx?ID=677), [Sigek](/Deities.aspx?ID=729) **Lesson** [Lesson of Decay](/Lessons.aspx?ID=26) **Duration** 1 minute --- You envision a simple bug and transform into a Medium animal battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as such as a ladybug or scarab for beetle), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the animal trait. You can Dismiss this spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:
  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 10 temporary Hit Points.
  • [Low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=416).
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +13, and your damage bonus is +2. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) condition). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) modifier of +13, unless your own is higher.
You gain specific abilities based on the form you choose: - **Beetle** Speed 25 feet; **Melee** mandibles, **Damage** 2d10 bludgeoning. - **Centipede** Speed 25 feet, climb 25 feet; [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415); **Melee** mandibles, **Damage** 1d8 piercing plus 1d4 [persistent poison](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). - **Mantis** Speed 40 feet; imprecise scent 30 feet; **Melee** foreleg, **Damage** 2d8 piercing. - **Scorpion** Speed 40 feet; [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415), [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) 60 feet; **Melee** stinger, **Damage** 1d8 piercing plus 1d4 [persistent poison](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29); **Melee** pincer (agile), **Damage** 1d6 bludgeoning. - **Spider** Speed 25 feet, climb 25 feet; [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415); **Melee** fangs, **Damage** 1d6 piercing plus 1d4 [persistent poison](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29); **Ranged** web ([range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** immobilizes the target for 1 round or until it Escapes. - **Ant** Speed 30 feet, climb 30 feet; **Melee** mandibles, **Damage** 2d6 bludgeoning. --- **Heightened (4th)** Your battle form is Large, and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You instead gain 15 temporary HP, attack modifier +16, damage bonus +6, and Athletics +16. **Heightened (5th)** Your battle form is Huge, and your attacks have 15-foot reach. You instead gain 20 temporary HP, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +2 and double damage dice (including persistent damage), and Athletics +20.

You pull a large handful of guts from your midsection. Removing these guts doesn't harm you. You can use the guts as 50 feet of rope to help you [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=33), and they help attach you to a wall. You move half as quickly as usual while climbing with your guts (minimum 5 feet), but you can attempt a DC 5 flat check whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. Your encouragement inspires your ally to succeed at a task. This counts as having taken sufficient preparatory actions to Aid your ally on a skill check of your choice, regardless of the circumstances. When you later use the Aid reaction, you can roll Performance instead of the normal skill check, and if you roll a failure, you get a success instead. If you are legendary in Performance, you automatically critically succeed.

 The GM might rule that you can't use this ability if the act of encouraging your ally would interfere with the skill check (such as a check to Sneak quietly or maintain a disguise).

You create several hidden mines throughout the area that explode when stepped on. Choose up to 6 unoccupied squares within range. A mine appears in each chosen square, visible only to you and your allies. A mine can’t be targeted and isn’t affected by area effects, but if it hasn’t been triggered by the end of the spell’s duration, it dissipates harmlessly. A creature that can see [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) creatures and objects can see the mines. A creature can also attempt a Perception check against your spell DC to Seek to find an invisible mine.

A creature who enters a square with an invisible mine triggers it, causing an explosion that deals 3d6 fire damage and 3d6 piercing damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save) to the creature and every creature in a 5-foot emanation from the mine’s square.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The fire damage and piercing damage dealt by a mine each increase by 1d6.

A creature that can see invisible creatures and objects can see the mines. A creature can also attempt a Perception check against your spell DC to Seek to find an invisible mine. A creature who enters a square with an invisible mine triggers it, causing an explosion that deals 3d6 fire damage and 3d6 piercing damage (basic Reflex save) to the creature and every creature in a 5-foot emanation from the mine’s square. Heightened (+1) The fire damage and piercing damage dealt by a mine each increase by 1d6.

<title level="1" right="Spell 3" pfs="Standard">
[Instant Parade](/Spells.aspx?ID=1288)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=16" />
<trait label="Aura" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=206" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Visual" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=163" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Firebrands](/Sources.aspx?ID=196) pg. 89

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 10-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

An illusory parade with dozens of participants and performers appears around you, following you as you move. The parade is lively and noisy, providing enough cover and distraction to hide among the crowd. You and other creatures can [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) inside the crowd, though creatures that disbelieve the illusion still see creatures within as normal. 

 You can choose to send the parade off with a 2-action activity, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait. When you do so, the parade no longer follows you and instead continues traveling in the direction of your choice. The parade travels 100 feet over 1 round and then disappears as the spell is Dismissed. You can otherwise Dismiss the spell normally if you prefer.

<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 95

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 10 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You pull earthen material out of the environment, then shape it into one or more earthenware objects that, in combination, can be up to light Bulk. Alternatively, you can cast this spell on objects previously created with this spell, extending their duration. No object can have intricate artistry or complex moving parts, can fulfill a cost or the like, or is made of anything more than clay or earth. Each object is obviously the product of temporary magic and thus can't be sold or passed off as a valuable item.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** You can create objects of up to 1 Bulk. They last 8 hours.

**Heightened (3rd)** You can create objects of up to 2 Bulk. They last 24 hours.
